description.narrative: This project is to facilitate a grant from the Cabinet Office to the Climate Centre for a series of pre-COP dialogues.

participating-org.narrative: Stichting International Red Cross Red Crescent Centre on Climate Change and Disaster Preparedness (Red Cross Red Crescent Climate Centre)

description.narrative: This grant has been facilitated between the Cabinet Office and BRC, paid to RCRCCC. Payment to BRC has been confirmed as of April 2022. The Cabinet Office is funding a series of virtual dialogues to share knowledge and identify practical actions that enable better management of rising risks across timescales, including more effective adaptation to climate change and earlier action in anticipation of extreme weather events. Discussions will unpack how these actions can align with the National Adaption Plans and Covid-19 recovery efforts. This includes sharing of insights to increase resilience to climate-related shocks as well as health crises in low income countries, with main focus on Latin America, Africa and Asia-Pacific
